# v2026.11.18

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.18.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.18.md).

This release covers **4 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- A held history job that a non-chargeable rule matches, such as an own-clinic job, now settles as No Charge in place, with no draft invoice. ([#548](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/548))
- The Sentry error reporter moves to 11.12.0, which closes two moderate dependency advisories (glob and minimatch). ([#549](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/549))

## Fixes

- Own-clinic history jobs no longer make drafts that a person must delete later. ([#548](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/548))
- [@sentry](https://github.com/sentry)/node 11.8.0 to 11.12.0. ([#549](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/549))
- The test lane runs without the npm cache, so a cache cannot change what CodeQL checks. CI only. ([#550](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/550))

## Contribution record

[CHANGELOG/records/2026.11.18.md](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/blob/main/CHANGELOG/records/2026.11.18.md) lists every pull request in this release once, with its related issues and thanks.
